requested_by: owner 2026-10-20 ('do it'): bring the market-anchored O/U review forward
question: Does v9 O/U 2.5 improve when anchored on the de-vigged market price with the model as a small correction?

data.model: v9 walk-forward probabilities p_base (v9's own train(), quarterly blocks 2024-01..2026-10, out-of-sample) from experiments/ou_info_inputs_2026_10/eval_rows.parquet
data.market_primary: standard track: football-data PRE-MATCH average Avg>2.5 / Avg<2.5 (recorded before kickoff, ~when v9 tips freeze); closing AvgC is NOT used as the anchor
data.market_secondary: new_format track: the frame's own odds_over25/odds_under25 (v9 captures, timing not guaranteed) - reported, never decisive

arms.ANCHOR: logit p = logit p_mkt + w*(logit p_v9 - logit p_mkt); w fitted by log loss on all EARLIER blocks only, clipped to [0, 0.40] standard / [0, 0.45] new_format (v11 caps); first block uses w=0.20
arms.ANCHOR_LR: sensitivity only: logistic regression on [logit p_mkt, logit p_v9] fitted on earlier blocks

primary_metric: log loss on identical rows, ANCHOR minus V9, standard track
decision_rule: ANCHOR is a v9 PROPOSAL candidate only if dLL(ANCHOR-V9) <= -0.001 AND 90% day-block bootstrap CI upper < 0. Any proposal goes to the owner with numbers; nothing changes in v9 from this study.
secondary: dLL ANCHOR-MARKET (does the model add anything to the price)
calibration by side: claimed vs realised P(under) on bets
bet level at the pre-match price: edge = p - 1/odds >= 0.03 (live VALUABLE floor) and >= 0.08 (live MARKSMAN floor); count, ROI, split OVER/UNDER, bootstrap CI
frozen: no thresholds, caps or arms are changed after results are seen
